details: Bitcoin and Ethereum spot Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) collectively recorded $282 million in inflows on July 11th, breaking an eight-week streak of net outflows. This suggests a stabilizing institutional investor sentiment despite broader market uncertainties.
title: Bitcoin & Ethereum ETFs See $282M Inflow, Snap Outflow Streak

details: Standard Chartered analysts have reaffirmed their projection for Bitcoin to reach $100,000 by year-end 2026. This outlook comes as markets gain a clearer understanding of Strategy Inc.'s shift in Bitcoin strategy, which now involves repositioning holdings as collateral for financial products rather than solely for accumulation, a move that initially caused some market uncertainty.
title: Standard Chartered Reiterates $100K Bitcoin Target Amid Saylor Strategy Clarity

details: Bitcoin's price has shown resilience, trading above the $63,000-$64,000 mark over the weekend despite escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Analysts are closely monitoring the impact of these global events on traditional markets and how Bitcoin continues to act as a liquid asset during such times.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $64K Amid Geopolitical Tensions

details: The cryptocurrency market experienced significant liquidations totaling $63.76 million in the past 24 hours. Short positions accounted for the majority of these liquidations at $36.70 million, while long positions saw $27.06 million liquidated, indicating a period of heightened volatility.
title: Crypto Market Sees $63.76M in Liquidations Over 24 Hours

details: The Hedera-based lending protocol Bonzo Lend was reportedly exploited for $9 million. The exploit occurred after its Supra verifier allegedly accepted a manipulated price update, highlighting ongoing security vulnerabilities within the decentralized finance (DeFi) ecosystem.
title: Hedera Lending Protocol Bonzo Lend Exploited for $9M
